policy.rule: An official or institutional image is a canonical reference, not proof of a reusable license. A small local derivative may be used only for editorial identification or discussion, with a credit and source link and without zoom or download. Full-quality, decorative or promotional use requires recorded terms or permission; otherwise use a typographic fallback.
